title: The path from playtest to production
summary: Assets34 / Source04 is the current public Windows diagnostic playtest on GitHub. The exact public ZIP passed anonymous HTTPS download/hash verification, fresh extraction, Solo smoke and the complete headless same-PC two-process no-purchase Zombie baseline. Full runtime, visual/human/hardware, restart, separate-PC, six-role/Horde/full-purchase and sustained 30-FPS acceptance remain open. winter-hunt.com HTTPS was verified October 20, 2026.

candidate.label: Core9 / Visual05 / 334BFEFE
candidate.state: Public test build / runtime acceptance incomplete
candidate.passed: Visual05 passed managed compilation of four assemblies / 1,067 C# inputs, a three-biome bake, all 1,864 required native cases (zero failed or skipped), and Windows build/package verification. EngineFinale passed six biome/mode proofs with 114 scene/HUD PNGs. Flight passed with one rendered host and five headless local peers; accepted players exited naturally.
candidate.limits: These bounded passes do not close Zombie Horde or full ZombieCoopPurchase, which failed on rounds06-fix2 and were not rerun by Visual05. The exact public ZIP later passed Solo smoke and showed live initialized Zombie actors, but its complete cooperative diagnostic failed. Interactive Normal/Zombie opening-menu selection, sustained 30-FPS startup behavior, human gameplay/listening/visual acceptance, physical controllers/Deck and separate-PC Internet/Steam/voice remain open. Visual05 was packaged from the then-uncommitted candidate; this historical build statement does not describe the latest private branch. No merge or release-ready claim is made.
candidate.camp: The unchanged public ZIP was tested with fresh isolated Zombie saves initialized directly by diagnostic arguments. Both peers reported Zombie mode, 12 issued live actors, about 6.36 m of actual pursuit and 18 mirrored contact damage; the guest made 12 distinct real bow kills. Later blocked-approach and physical party-exit assertions failed, and both peers exited naturally with code 1. This proves bounded presence, not interactive menu selection, unrestricted combat or a complete camp/purchase gate.
candidate.flight: Visual05 Flight finale: 200.63 average FPS, p95 8.45 ms, p99 9.86 ms and worst 140.46 ms at 43 live AI, D3D11, 1280 x 800, on i7-14700K / RTX 5070. This single recorded workload is not a 30-FPS startup test, controlled before/after optimization, isolated effects cost, six rendered computers, Internet measurement or proof of natural thousands.

performance.state: Failed: p95 and strict melee-kill gate

historicalDensity.measurement: Historical Core8 only: one fixed-seed, manually staged ordinary-AI solo diagnostic with 30-second phases, 1280 x 800 D3D11, 120 FPS cap, vSync off, i7-14700K / RTX 5070. Exceptional threats were isolated. GPU timing was unavailable. Active counts are separate from camera-frustum bounds; occlusion visibility was not measured. These density measurements were not rerun or accepted by Visual05.
historicalDensity.route: A seeded Core7 HOME-return route rejected after real contact. Core8 passed another seed; the original failure is still open.
historicalDensity.optimization: The small Core7/Core8 predicate comparison showed mixed, inconclusive changes. No meaningful general performance improvement is claimed.
historicalDensity.label: Historical Core8 density diagnostic

candidate.identityNote: This identity describes the unchanged public Visual05 test ZIP linked above. Later source-only or private candidates do not replace that download or inherit its acceptance evidence.

phases.title: Finish the endless survival loop
criteria: Current bundled Zombie rules use finite increasing enemy-budget rounds with no win, nuke or finale. Solo first down or a team wipe ends the run; teammates can rescue, and late join enters next round.

Bow start and permanent earned weapons/upgrades replace the earlier timed waves, three lives and rotating weapon restrictions. Preparation/intermission lasts 30 seconds; once per combat round, shared camp allowance lasts 30 simulation seconds.

Two grenades remain separate from weapon slots. Bosses arrive every third round. Ownership, upgrade purchases, allowance, rescue and persisted round state must remain consistent across the party and process restart.
Earn compatible perks and combinations from kills, loot and harvests, with no paid loot boxes. Natural sustained play and boss behavior under load still require acceptance.
phases.gate: Assets34 passed the complete headless same-PC two-process no-purchase Zombie baseline: 12 real kills, round/save transitions, camp grace/contact, grenade debit/refill and same-wave entry/readback. The archived Visual05 complete cooperative diagnostic failed. Earlier Horde and full cooperative-purchase failures remain open. Natural sustained play, team wipe/rescue, process restart, purchases and boss cadence under load remain unaccepted.

phases.title: Prove crowded pursuit and performance
criteria: Fast contact attacks within about half a second, readable lunges and fair knockback; crowds keep pursuing and attacking. Animals jump or reposition to reach juniper perches.
Admit hordes throughout the map from multiple directions, scaling toward thousands through pooling, LOD and spatial/navigation work. Report real active AI separately from proxies.
Keep cheap visible frozen/batched corpse piles bounded, with no unbounded physics, revival or duplicate rewards.
phases.gate: Historical Core8: 512 staged phase passed; 1024 failed; 2048 was unmeasured. The later rounds06-fix2 Horde failure reached 128 ordinary AI with zero proxies; higher phases and melee/cooldown acceptance remained unresolved and were not rerun by Visual05. Production ordinary-AI cap is 512 with fallback 128 and zero proxies. Natural thousands, dense combined threats, route reliability, corpse persistence, delayed/reordered leaps and six-peer density remain unaccepted. The Visual05 Flight result does not replace a density gate.

phases.title: Raise the original visual quality
criteria: Improve original hunter, animal, monster and UFO models, textures, rigs and lighting while preserving silhouettes, hurtboxes and combat readability.
Keep mitten/block hands in first and third person, improve held flamethrower presentation, and keep a sky beam on lost gear until recovered or empty.

Retain bounded weapon/environment particles and existing pooled left/right boot-sole snow footprints; validate slope contact, fade and co-op consistency. Add a shared adaptive effects budget when measured.
phases.gate: Assets34 adds campfire and existing devil-elk artwork with scoped native image review; boss side/warning and mid/far camp occlusion remain unresolved. Shown gameplay images and the 114 EngineFinale/27 encounter captures are earlier Visual05 evidence, not new Assets34 screenshots. Historical Profile2 and Core8 evidence remain separate. Full-body silhouette, natural fights, warning/HUD readability, dense-session effects cost and human visual acceptance remain open.

phases.title: Make menus and profiles clear
criteria: Native Unity Normal / Zombie, Start New / Load / Resume, pause, settings and results flows remain readable at supported resolutions, with keyboard/controller focus, back and cancel.
Editable nonunique nickname and color preview persist across reopen/rejoin separately from private stable identity. Public results require explicit sharing consent.
phases.gate: Assets34 uses matching-build protocol 61 / save 24 and retains source-derived Normal/Zombie, profile and camp controls. Its 63 scoped native cases and packaged diagnostics do not establish interactive opening-menu selection. Separate-process color replication, late join/rejoin, keyboard/controller focus, physical Deck and human menu acceptance remain open. Hunter is the current playable class. Archived Visual05 retains its original protocol 58 / save 22.

phases.title: Earn perks and playable monster classes
criteria: Expand earned perk inventory and combinations, preserving permanent earned weapon ownership, upgrades, grenades and live weapon state.
Normal map victories unlock persisted playable classes. Bigfoot is a strong melee tank; Devil trades health for strong melee and bounded magic. Neither uses hunter guns.
Resolve the proposed third class's recorded creature identity before committing it; the current proposal is an Ash Crown undead-elk silhouette at fair player scale.
phases.gate: Current enemies are not playable classes. Class authority, unlock rollback/rejoin, progression, camera, collider, animation and balance still require implementation and validation.

phases.title: Put global records in every map
criteria: Physical boards partition records by map, mode, rules/version, class and team. Rank Normal completions separately from Zombie waves, time and kills.
Keep immutable run/private identity separate from mutable nicknames, with consent, idempotent retries and bounded cached/offline/loading/error states.
phases.gate: Only an opt-in local queue bounded to 16 exists. Contract and fake-adapter/UI work can proceed; no connected global service or internet-wide leaderboard is implemented. Service access is a later dependency.

phases.title: Verify the exact test build before promotion
criteria: Run bound managed/native, build/package and persistence tests for the final source; cover repeated camp entry, waves, high-density combat and Normal regression.

Retain the passed Visual05 EngineFinale actual-screen/HUD and Flight evidence. Complete sustained 30-FPS startup verification, human gameplay/listening/visual review, physical controller/Deck and separate-PC Internet six-player checks; a rendered host with local headless peers is distinct evidence.
phases.gate: Assets34 passed exact public GitHub download/hash, fresh extraction, Solo smoke and the complete headless same-PC two-process no-purchase Zombie baseline. The archived Visual05 complete cooperative diagnostic failed. Opening-menu selection, no-argument launch, process-restart persistence and sustained 30-FPS startup remain open. Human playtest, controllers/Deck and separate-PC multiplayer remain open, as do six-role/Horde/full-purchase and full visual acceptance. Preserve failed evidence and earlier ZIPs; scoped checks do not establish full acceptance. winter-hunt.com HTTPS was verified October 20, 2026.

phases.title: Pass the human and Steam release gates
criteria: Verify onboarding, app identity, store/pricing/content survey, playable build review, install/launch and discount eligibility in the authorized Steam workflow.
Every actual game release updates this tracker with the matching download and instructions, then verifies the live site. Public release, merge and promotion require their remaining approvals.
phases.gate: October 19 store-page review submission, November 2 release-candidate acceptance and build-review submission, and November 16 release remain planning targets, not completed submissions or approvals. Account/app identity, owner-approved store preview and Steam gates remain unverified. Assets34 is an authorized GitHub public diagnostic playtest, not a Steam or production release. Visual05 and older ZIPs, hashes and release dates are unchanged. winter-hunt.com HTTPS was verified October 20, 2026; direct GitHub delivery remains verified separately.

routine.label: Historical Profile2 staged evidence / superseded by packaged Visual05
routine.passed: Before Visual05, Profile2 passed four managed assemblies, a fresh three-biome bake and 145 focused native cases: 76 rules, 43 menu/appearance/footprint flows, 24 campaign-reset/results regressions and two GPU capture cases. This historical focused run had zero failures or forced cleanup.
routine.visual: 72 original-game PNGs were produced: 65 staged hands/equipment poses, two original-rig palette/mittens renders and five bloody-trail/control renders. Representative images were inspected. These are staged URP renders, not actual menu/HUD or human art acceptance.
routine.limits: These staged URP renders do not prove packaged menu/HUD or human art acceptance. Visual05 subsequently built and packaged the later source identified above; it has its own separate native and packaged receipts. Historical Core8 density results cannot be transferred to either changed source. Later private/source-only work is not the public download.

continuation.passed: Source04 passed four managed assemblies covering 1,288 C# inputs, with 46 baseline and 46 candidate warnings and no changed diagnostics. The fresh Unity import audit completed with no audit errors and natural exit code 0: 8,595 raw inputs, 122 materials and 244 generated material/metadata outputs. All 63 scoped native cases passed: 48 EditMode, 8 PlayMode, 5 graphics-target, 1 boss and 1 camp case. These results apply to this exact source; they do not replace the public Visual05 package evidence. The Windows Mono diagnostic build completed with natural exit code 0. The Assets34 ZIP hash and all 261 freshly extracted file hashes match the saved package receipts; the extracted instructions also passed their exact-template check. The exact extracted package now passed Solo smoke and the complete headless, same-PC two-process Zombie baseline without the purchase branch. Both Zombie roles exited naturally with code 0 after 490.96 seconds overall, with 42 saved evidence files verified and unchanged inputs. The baseline cleared 12 actual enemies with 24 bow shots, then verified the paid round save/intermission, round-two camp grace/contact, grenade debit/refill and same-wave repeat-entry/readback.

Current Assets34 Solo and no-purchase Zombie baseline passes are separate from Visual05's historical failed cooperative diagnostic. No-argument launch, interactive menu, persistence across a process restart, human/controller/Deck, separate-PC/Internet multiplayer, six-role/Horde, full cooperative purchase and sustained 30 FPS remain unverified. sourceEvidence.publicReleaseMeaning: Diagnostic public playtest only; full runtime, human, performance and Steam/production release acceptance remain false.

continuation.density: A historical six-role clock baseline covered 11.93 common seconds at low density. A later fixed 1,024 attempt failed during setup and did not establish ordinary-AI capacity. A separate private cp32 six-role comparison failed on screen readback; its strict comparison was not run, and a visible rerun still needs human approval. The original 1,024 target remains open; four-versus-six and fewer/faster enemies are private comparisons only.
continuation.gates: Six players remains the default. Opening-menu interaction, human gameplay/listening/visual review, physical Steam Deck/controller, sustained 30 FPS, readable UI/text entry and separate-PC multiplayer remain open. Earlier Horde and full cooperative-purchase failures are retained. Existing Deck hooks and Windows desktop FPS are not Deck or Proton proof. No confirmed Deck installation route is published for this Windows build.
continuation.visualReview: The root image review inspected all 13 original library sheets and all 196 model/material tiles, plus 6 original boss images and 6 original camp images. These controlled static views support scoped diagnostic build preparation. They do not establish animation, full in-world visual fit, human readability or sustained performance.
continuation.visualLimits: A foreground tree heavily obscures the boss side view. Terrain hides parts of the charge lane, and only one substantial eruption ring is visibly established despite three enabled warning renderers. Mid/far camp views are screened by vegetation, with some cropped or reverse-facing sign text. Full boss/camp fit and warning/approach readability remain open. GPU timing and draw counts are unavailable and remain unknown; whole-editor samples are not packaged FPS or isolated effect cost.
